likelyCauses.description: A gas leak may be present

questions.text: Is water coming out of the tap?

likelyCauses.description: The sediment filter may be overdue

steps: Switch off and unplug the purifier.
Close the inlet valve.
Unscrew the filter housing with a cloth below it.
Swap in the filter cartridge.
Hand-tighten the housing, open the inlet, and plug the purifier back in.
Run water for two minutes and discard it.
callProIf: It still beeps after the new filter

source.note: Starter DIY filter replacement steps; verify against the appliance manual

likelyCauses.description: The tank-full sensor may need a reset

steps: Unplug the purifier for two minutes.
Draw a glass of water from the tap.
Plug the purifier back in and check the light.
callProIf: The alarm continues after the reset

source.note: Starter sensor reset steps; verify against the appliance manual

likelyCauses.description: The RO membrane may need a technician

fix.summary: Have a technician inspect the RO membrane
callProIf: Water flow remains low after filter service

questions.text: Is the inlet tap under the sink open?

likelyCauses.description: The inlet tap may be closed

steps: Check that the inlet tap under the sink is open.
callProIf: The tap is open but water still does not flow

steps: Switch off and unplug the purifier.
Replace the sediment filter cartridge and check for leaks.
callProIf: Water still does not flow after replacement

likelyCauses.description: The membrane may need a technician

fix.summary: Have a technician inspect the RO membrane
callProIf: No water flows after inlet and filter checks

fix.summary: Have a technician inspect the pump
callProIf: The pump is noisy or the purifier remains without water

likelyCauses.description: A water connection may be leaking

fix.summary: Keep away and call a technician

likelyCauses.description: The carbon filter may be overdue

steps: Switch off and unplug the purifier.
Replace the carbon filter cartridge.
Run and discard water as directed by the manual.
Switch off the inverter and mains supply.
Check the level indicator and top up only with distilled water if the manual permits.
callProIf: The level is low but you are unsure how to top it up

source.note: Starter inverter maintenance guidance; follow the battery manual

steps: Switch off mains power before inspecting the inverter.
Do not touch exposed conductors; ask a technician if a terminal is loose.
callProIf: A cable is damaged or a terminal is hot

likelyCauses.description: The battery may need professional testing

fix.summary: Have a technician test the battery
callProIf: The battery still will not charge after basic checks

likelyCauses.description: An electrical fault may be present
The AC filter may be dirty

steps: Switch off the AC.
Remove and clean the filter according to the manual.
Let it dry fully before reinstalling.
callProIf: The AC still does not cool after cleaning

source.note: Starter filter cleaning guidance; follow the unit manual

likelyCauses.description: The refrigerant may need professional inspection

fix.summary: Have an AC technician inspect the refrigerant system
callProIf: Cooling remains weak after filter cleaning

likelyCauses.description: The condensate drain may be blocked

fix.summary: Have a technician inspect the drain
